items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our original GRIDSHARD emerald repair robot. Create ONE ACTIVE MAINTENANCE POSE of this EXACT same robot. Preserve its green/silver/gold palette, single cyan sensor, tracked chassis, body proportions, exact camera, framing, transparent background and premium chunky beveled 2.5D rendering. Keep the tracks and central body in the same location and scale. Change ONLY its articulated arm pose: both arms are visibly raised above their resting position, bent toward the upper-right, the pincer half open as if stabilizing a repair task and the nozzle directed toward a neighbor to the upper-right. Keep arms compact and fully within the existing square canvas with clear transparent margin. Do not add a second robot, repaired target, beam, sparks, fog, plus/crescent symbol, text, motion arrows, background or floor. No recolor, no redesign of head or tracks. Genuine transparent alpha. This is a pose candidate for animation, not a sprite sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our original emerald/mint cooling machine with icy-cyan three-blade fan, side coolant pipe and silver radiator fins. Preserve the recognizable upper fan housing, class colors, materials, camera and chunky crisp GRIDSHARD 2.5D rendering. Replace its four separate feet with ONE INTEGRATED LOW SWIVEL ATTACHMENT: a broad dark graphite circular fixed foot, green/silver rotating bearing ring and a short visible central mechanical yoke supporting the original upper cooler. The bearing must clearly read as allowing the fan housing to turn toward neighboring modules. Make the bottom support proportionate and compact, not a tall turret tower or separate UI plate; fit complete device with 10 percent transparent margin. Upper housing remains at the same front-right three-quarter orientation, no rotation illusion or multiple views. Genuine transparent background. No cold air, vapor, frost, ice particles, beam, direction arrows, text, numbers, floor or external shadow. Produce one coherent device; do not add other machinery or replace the fan by a symbol.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original transparent physical defense module for GRIDSHARD, proposed name DAMPENER, replacing the armor suit depiction without changing its existing self-damage-reduction and self-repair mechanics. Images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: broad saturated color faces, chunky premium casual-strategy 2.5D mechanical volume, clean strong edge contours, crisp simple chamfers, pale upper-left highlights. Do not draw swords or a chest. Subject: a compact LOW COBALT-BLUE KINETIC DAMPING UNIT, one self-contained squat industrial chassis with a central thick shock-absorbing piston stack and four short angled blue protective shell panels visibly mechanically attached around it. Two broad pale-silver spring/piston collars communicate compression and recovery, small cyan functional window, graphite recesses. Clearly a buildable sci-fi machine mounted in a circuit cell, NOT wearable body armor, human torso, helmet, pointed shield, barrier dome, generator orb, coil amplifier or heraldic emblem. Mostly rich royal/cobalt blue DEFENSE housing, restrained pale silver and cyan. Keep very few large readable mechanical parts, distinct silhouette at 32-48 pixels. Shallow front-right three-quarter camera with entire unit visible on square canvas and 10-12 percent clear margin. Genuine transparent alpha. No text, numbers, UI plate, card, floor, external shadow, sparks, particles, beam, shield bubble or background. One device only, no variants sheet. This machine protects and restores itself; do not depict protecting other devices.
